julia.docs: Filing PR #6942 for the SDK migration page. Reviewer left one blocking comment about a behavior mismatch between SDK wrappers and raw HTTP re: streaming headers.

nate-sdk: Can you paste the comment? I thought our wrappers set body param "response_mode" not headers.

julia.docs: Reviewer says: "The example shows setting header X-Redwood-Response-Mode: streaming; but the SDK uses body param and docs should prefer that. Also need to call out minimum runtime that fixes the SSE vs JSONL ambiguity."

leo-runtime: That's accurate. Historically we supported both header and body param; newer SDKs prefer body param. For the migration guide we should recommend SDKs set response_mode in the request body (response_mode: "streaming") and avoid header reliance.

nate-sdk: Ok. For parity, we'll update Python example to use response_mode="streaming" in the call signature. Also confirm whether default is buffered.

leo-runtime: Default is buffered unless stream flag or response_mode is explicitly set. Also note: runtime 0.9.4 unified header/body semantics and fixed a truncation bug when prefix-caching + streaming. Recommend stating runtime >= 0.9.4 for streaming migrations.

emma-se: Reviewer also asked about the interplay of max_tokens with streaming: does partial last-chunk flush happen early? We should add a short note that max_tokens is enforced server-side and you won't get extra tokens beyond the cap; streaming can yield partial token chunks but stopping still respects max_tokens.

julia.docs: I'll make these edits: switch header example to body param, add short runtime >= 0.9.4 note, add max_tokens sentence, and re-run preview.

ci-bot: docs-preview run queued by julia.docs (build 142210). Will report results here.

nate-sdk: Proposed Python snippet change:

```
# explicit streaming via body param
resp_iter = client.generate("Summarize...", response_mode="streaming")
for part in resp_iter:
    print(part.delta)
```

julia.docs: Nice, keep the buffered default example above it.

ci-bot: docs-preview success (build 142210) 4 (linkcheck passed). Reviewer can re-review.

julia.docs: Requesting final review from @leo-runtime and @nate-sdk. If approved I'll merge.

leo-runtime: Reviewed  looks good. Approving.

nate-sdk: LGTM. Merging now.

julia.docs: Merged PR #6942. Release note: "docs(migration): recommend body param for streaming and require runtime >=0.9.4" :tada:
